citations.text: L. A. Zetterström (2021). Knowledge Graph Embeddings.

description: Directed knowledge graph encoding relationships between 14 countries. Edges represent 55 interaction types (e.g. 'exports', 'accusation', 'aidgiven'). The same country pair can have multiple relation types, creating a dense multigraph. Used as a standard benchmark for knowledge graph embedding methods.
name: Nations Knowledge Graph
